Basis worksheet

Your new basis is the untaxed part of the note plus the gain you report now and your repossession costs, which roughly restores the basis you had before the sale.

LineWhat it holdsAmount

If you later resell the property, your holding period includes the time you owned it before the original sale plus the time since the repossession, but not the time the buyer held it.
